Unusually for this kind of report, the Results abstract does print 95% CIs alongside each arm's CDR-SB change, and they match reading B exactly.

notes: This trial designates two primary outcomes: 'The primary outcomes were change from baseline on the Clinical Dementia Rating–Sum of Boxes score from baseline to week 73 and assessments of the safety and tolerability for semorinemab compared with placebo.' Safety/tolerability is co-primary with CDR-SB, and the Safety Monitoring section separately names 'The primary safety outcomes were the nature, frequency, and severity of adverse events (AEs) and serious AEs'. Rulings #1 and #2 concern the CDR-SB limb of the primary outcome, which is the limb the readings addressed; a downstream record should not represent CDR-SB as the sole primary endpoint.

The effect-estimate and CI values cited by the two readings are drawn from the abstract Results paragraph; the same figures appear graphically in Figure 2 (error bars = 95% CIs), which is not machine-readable in this markdown rendering.
